Rolling no-look-ahead backtest

Ten distinct numbers per drawing. Training uses only prior drawings of the selected draw type, through the selected end date. Box payout is modeled as a $1 wager on each number's full box permutation set; tickets with fewer permutations have larger payouts. Straight $1 payout: Pick 3 $500, Pick 4 $5,000. Box $1 payout: straight prize divided by distinct permutations. These are illustrative conventional payouts, not verified Missouri Lottery ticket-specific rules. No Wild Ball, taxes, or promotions.

Choose settings and select Run backtest.

For research and paper tracking only. Each exact combination has equal probability in a fair drawing; past frequency does not improve future odds.
